title: Quick Reference Card: Service Tenure and the Notice Allowance on Electric Service Agreements
content:
**Electric Service Agreement — allowance under the notice minimum by length of service.** Length of service is counted in whole calendar months from the agreement's start date to the payment day. The returned-payment allowance is the allowance under the notice minimum as the agreement's returned-payment history sets it.

| Whole calendar months in service | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 96 or more | the larger of the returned-payment allowance and one fifth (0.2) of the agreement's most recent bill, never more than one cent (USD 0.01) under the notice minimum |
| at least 48, fewer than 96 | the larger of the returned-payment allowance and one tenth (0.1) of the agreement's most recent bill, never more than one cent under the notice minimum |
| fewer than 48 | the returned-payment allowance as it is |

The part taken from the most recent bill is rounded to the cent before the larger figure is chosen; the limit of one cent under the notice minimum is applied to the larger figure. The notice minimum is the schedule's minimum past-due balance for a disconnection notice. The resulting allowance is the one subtracted from the past-due balance.

**Boundary (hypothetical).** Start date 1 March 2018: on a payment day of 1 March 2026 the agreement has 96 whole months; on 28 February 2026 it has 95. On 1 March 2022 it has 48; on 28 February 2022 it has 47.

**Card figures (hypothetical: notice minimum USD 80.00, most recent bill USD 236.40)**

| Months | Returned-payment allowance | Bill part | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 40.00 | 47.28 | 47.28 |
| 60 | 40.00 | 23.64 | 40.00 |
| 60 | 0.00 | 23.64 | 23.64 |
| 30 | 0.00 | none | 0.00 |
| 100, bill USD 520.00 | 40.00 | 104.00 | 79.99 |
